module.name: CNEInstance Ready Gate
module.description: Cloud-agnostic readiness gate for a BNK CNEInstance. Polls the operator-written .status (F5TmmAvailable && CNEControllerAvailable, with a status.state Ready/Running fallback) after the CR is applied, dumps pod diagnostics and fails closed on timeout. Replaces fire-and-forget cneinstance_ready=true literals. Per-cloud catalogs vendor this and call it after their cneinstall step.

required.name: instance_namespace
required.description: Namespace where the CNEInstance CR lives (forge EKS: operator_namespace, default f5-operator).

required.name: instance_name
required.description: Name of the CNEInstance CR to poll.

optional.name: kubeconfig_file
optional.description: Path to an existing kubeconfig. Empty = materialise from forge_kubeconfig_content.

optional.name: cne_crd_name
optional.description: Fully-qualified CNEInstance CRD name for the CRD pre-gate.

optional.name: condition_timeout_seconds
optional.description: Max seconds to wait for the readiness conditions before failing closed.

optional.name: crd_timeout_seconds
optional.description: Max seconds to wait for the CNEInstance CRD to be registered.

key_outputs.name: cneinstance_ready
key_outputs.description: Gate output — the readiness null_resource id, produced only after the operator reported the instance functional. Never a literal true.
